rules.diagnosis: pnpm audit on the candidate lockfile reports new vulnerable dependency paths introduced by the update (GHSA advisory paths present on the PR head but absent from the base lockfile). Select a dependency version that keeps the update without introducing new advisory paths.
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile fails on the candidate head because the updated dependency range no longer matches pnpm-lock.yaml. Align the manifest and lockfile to a compatible, installable version.
pnpm lint fails on the candidate head after the dependency update (reproduced lint errors from changed dependency types or APIs). Fix call sites and configuration without weakening lint rules.
pnpm build fails on the candidate head after the dependency update (reproduced build error). Adapt configuration and call sites to the updated dependency API while preserving public behavior.
pnpm test fails on the candidate head after the dependency update (reproduced failing unit tests). Update call sites and expectations to the new dependency behavior without removing coverage.
